messages.content: Can you take a cost optimisation pass?
Yes, taking a cost optimisation pass.
Blockers?

Flaky jobs get one automatic retry. Nobody needs to think about the NAT gateway consolidated to one per region anymore. The pager went off twice overnight because of a plan diff from an untracked manual console change. The pager went off twice overnight because of an apply failing on an IAM eventual consistency delay.
Anything broken?

Thanks to IAM roles scoped per service, the on-call pages stopped. Tagging enforced through a provider default came off the board this morning. Ping me if anything seems wrong. The bulk of the diff sits in terraform/vpc.tf.
Where are we?
CloudWatch alarms on the error rate metric is behind us now.
Status please.
The logs are easier to read now. The dashboard lit up red with an S3 bucket name collision across accounts.
Carry on.

The VPC with public and private subnets across three zones has been live since Tuesday with no complaints. Somebody has to own a drift detection job on a daily schedule before Friday. No incidents were reported this week. Had to untangle terraform/iam.tf first.
Status please.
Separate accounts for production and staging is the direction we committed to.
Where are we?
Policy-as-code checks in the plan stage keeps getting pushed to next sprint.
Status please.
A module for the standard service deployment is behind us now. Terragrunt for the DRY module wiring is the direction we committed to.
Private subnets for every compute workload feels like the right fit here.
We might revisit this next quarter. Had to untangle .github/workflows/plan.yml first. The bulk of the diff sits in modules/service/main.tf. Fine by me.
Next steps for a cost optimisation pass?
An RDS instance with automated backups has been live since Tuesday with no complaints.
AWS as the single cloud provider feels like the right fit here.
terraform/outputs.tf grew by a couple hundred lines. Sure, on it. The bulk of the diff sits in terraform/variables.tf. I'll post a recap later.
